title: Independently audit two-image dirty-return obstruction
body:
## Summary

Independently audit PR4991's literal original and phase-repaired two-image dirty-return boundary for every positive width and every fixed nonzero complex coefficient pair. Corroborate its nonsingular affine-volume classification and supply the separate singular rank-drop implication: a target rank strictly between `(q-1)d` and `qd` cannot contain any singular `M tensor I_d` factor.

```diff
 PR4991 all-coefficient completed boundary
 + independent absolute-phase/source and eventual-width proof audit
 + explicit singular-coefficient rank argument
 + PR4998 transformed inverse-partner boundary control
```

## Evidence

- **Before:** The singular coefficient paragraph notes singularity, while the volume lemma assumes invertible final output; the missing rank implication was not explicit.
  **After:** The written proof handles the singular cases without taking a zero determinant logarithm. A code-disjoint checker binds actual source phases, exact width-one/two character counts and integer determinants, and the literal compensated program on all 16/128 independent columns over F17.
- Normal replay: 0.17s; optimized replay: 0.23s. Registered replay, metadata/pins, committed bytes/source history, export integrity, and Git-free normal/optimized replay pass. Necessary pending-source bytes, notices, original paths/heads and hashes are retained; predecessor verifiers are never imported or executed.
- Credit Cinna Davis (#4991/#4998), lee-phys (#4688), Yiyang/Lyy-iiis (#4710), Dugongue (#4743), Jacob Alan Sussman (#4628), eumemic and Swapnil Jain. Prepared by JoyboyBrian with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

Adds one scoped research package. No selected-frontier, supplier, kappa, clean-workspace exclusion, width-dependent-word exclusion or Gaussian-consumer admission claim. The all-width/all-complex result is a written proof; finite checks are corroboration, not proof-assistant verification. Canonical investigation: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5008.
